rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Mountaineer 
"We despise Cahuzak as much as you and your kind... High King Morok Cloudkeeper will make you repent attacking us!"

Hubert de Lalye 
"You are unworthy of our trust. How dare you take what is mine? You will regret this act of treason!"

Sorcerer 
"This town is near the Mountain Clans fortress. We must be careful around these parts!"

Cultist 
"Hubert de Lalye burned this town after they refused to deliver him three virgin girls... He is a truly evil, master."

Master Thug 
"Bernard of Cahuzak was Hubert de Lalye's Uncle. Bernard rebelled against the King during the First Great Wars a decade ago. Treachery runs strong in Hubert's veins..."

Peasant 
"If the King had not abandoned us, you would never have captured this town! Hubert de Lalye probably sent you..."

Death 
"Youuu will not evade ussss for long, demon infant... Mortis hasss neeed of you."

Bethrezen 
"All bow before Uther! I am the lost heir of the Empire! If you join my ranks, we can all rule these lands together!"

Hubert de Lalye 
"Uther?! With you here I can easily rally all the Empire under the same banner! The alliance is accepted!"

Bethrezen 
"A wise decision, Mortal... Now your task is to overthrow the weak Demosthene!"

Sorcerer 
"Hubert de Lalye's territory lies ahead... He seems as cruel as you are almighty!"

Counselor 
"The King has abandoned these lands master... We might submit the area with ease!"

Demonologist 
"Bethrezen is dead! We have failed our God... Saved him from imprisonment, only to allow him to be killed! How long will it be before we can venture into the world as demons? The Legions are condemned to obscurity!"

Hubert de Lalye 
"Foul Beasts! It is I who shall teach you the meaning of evil! Your intrusion in my domains shall not be forgotten..."

Counselor 
"A messenger brings us news from Hubert de Lalye, Master!"

"The message says... 
'I trust no demonic creature! Leave these lands at once...'  
...A threat!"

Counselor 
"I see that concluding an alliance with this vermin will not be an easy task! But, we must gain their trust if we are to survive against the Undead forces which threaten us..."

Hubert's Guard
"Uther! You are back! Wherever have you been these last ten years? We will join you my lord, I am now yours to command!"

Hubert's Guard
"Lord Uther! You may pass here! De Lalye will be pleased to meet you..."

Squire 
"Master Uther?! You have survived... How is this possible? Please, accept my help! I wish to join your ranks..."

Counselor 
"We must ally with Hubert de Lalye... It is our only hope! We have many enemies which would like to see us dead, Master!"

Bethrezen 
"This de Lalye will not resist when he sees me! That foolish human will ally with us..."

Hubert de Lalye 
"Uther!? Uther, the lost heir?"

Bethrezen 
"Yes de Lalye! I am the one called Uther... I will reward you greatly for helping me to  take the Empire."

Hubert de Lalye 
"I will serve you, Uther..."

Veteran 
"Begone, demons! Do you not see that the Clans have the power to quell any of your attacks!"

Bethrezen 
"Why should we fear half-men such as you... I have escaped your prison and vanquished your puny armies before!"

Veteran 
"You were warned, beasts. Now you must face us..."

Counselor 
"Hubert de Lalye impaled all of the people you see in these fields... He is truly worthy of joining our ranks!"
